libs.note: BH-9075 (BH-9067.3). The D1 parks table: bin/lib/jobs/parks.sh is the client (parks_put, parks_changed, parks_prune) and bin/lib/parks-write.sh the writers (pw_note, pw_flush, pw_queue_park, pw_note_outcome, pw_conductor_sync). The knobs are one file each in _lib.parks.knobs.d/; settings rows lib.parks.<env lowercased>.
